name: kami
description: Agent-first career intelligence and document typesetting skill for Codex: analyze authorized resumes and career profiles, interview for missing evidence, match target jobs, route 9 resume families with light/dark themes, and render ATS-safe polished resumes alongside Kami documents.

interface.longDescription: Kami helps an agent turn authorized old resumes, LinkedIn or Chinese career-platform profiles, and target job descriptions into a traceable candidate dossier. It interviews for missing latest-role evidence, matches the target role, chooses one of 9 resume families with light/dark themes, renders an expressive primary resume plus an ATS-safe companion when needed, and still supports Kami one-pagers, reports, letters, portfolios, slides, and landing pages.
defaultPrompt: Build a job-targeted resume from my old PDF and LinkedIn profile
Interview me about my latest role and generate an ATS resume
Make a polished one-pager from this brief
Turn this outline into a slide deck
